name: studio
description: Narrated, animated videos built around a learning goal, recorded evidence and fresh reviews. Polished by default: a beat sheet times picture and sound to the frame, polish is a planned stage judged on frame sequences with a rule for when it stops, and a measured mix keeps effects out of the words. Build in the background, with handoffs and hard stops, or follow along on the desk. Boards and an animatic settle the picture and pacing first. Replaces tutor.
